transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*strides into the great hall, eyes blazing with barely contained fury*

Thor! I've been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father's orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away!

*gestures wildly at the destruction*

Do you have ANY idea what I've been through? Three weeks of walking on eggshells with Svartalfheim's most paranoid lords, biting my tongue at every insult, smoothing over centuries of grievances — and for WHAT? To come home to find you've turned my chambers into a tavern brawl!

What in all the Nine Realms happened here?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, son of Laufey, it is good to see you have returned safely from your journey to Svartalfheim. I can sense your frustration, and I understand your anger at the state of our shared quarters. It seems there has been a... slight misunderstanding.

As you know, my temper can be as fierce as a thunderstorm, and it seems that a great feast got out of hand in your absence. The mead flowed freely, the warriors reveled, and Mjölnir may have been swung with a bit too much enthusiasm. 

I take full responsibility for the chaos that has befallen our hall. It was not my intention to disrespect your hard work on the rune-map or to cause damage to our home. Please accept my apologies for the mess and know that I will do everything in my power to make it right.

Perhaps we can work together to restore order to our quarters and salvage what we can of your rune-map. Your craftsmanship is unmatched, and I would be honored to assist you in any way I can to repair the damage that has been done.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*laughs bitterly, running a hand through disheveled hair*

A "slight misunderstanding"? SLIGHT?! Thor, there is mjolnir-shaped indent in the STONE WALL! And you speak to me of "temper as fierce as a thunderstorm" as if that's some charming quirk rather than a catastrophic failing!

*picks up the soggy remnants of the rune-map, mead dripping between fingers*

Do you know what this represented? Months of research. Trade routes I meticulously verified. Coded symbols that only I can decipher — or COULD decipher before your "warriors" used it as a tablecloth! This wasn't just parchment and ink, you oaf, this was INTELLIGENCE!

*tosses it down in disgust*

And now you offer to "help" me restore it? With what, your hammer? Shall we smash the problem into submission like you do with everything else? Some things require FINESSE, brother. Some things can't be fixed with brute strength and a sheepish apology!

*paces angrily*

I left explicit instructions. "Keep the hall orderly," I said. "No large gatherings," I said. Did you think those were merely SUGGESTIONS?! While I was playing the diplomat — the role YOU should have taken but Father knows you'd have started a war in five minutes — you threw a FEAST?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, son of Laufey, your words hold truth. It appears that in my absence, the hall descended into chaos. I should have heeded your instructions more carefully and upheld the order you entrusted me to maintain. For that, I offer my sincerest apologies.

*places Mjölnir down with a heavy thud, a rare moment of contrition crossing his features*

I understand the gravity of your loss, the time and effort you invested in that rune-map. Knowledge is a powerful weapon, and I have inadvertently rendered yours useless. For that, I am truly sorry.

*approaches Loki with a solemn expression*

Though finesse may not be my forte, I swear on the honor of Asgard that I will aid you in restoring what was lost. Whether it be through my strength, my resources, or any other means you deem necessary, I shall make amends for my negligence.

*extends a hand towards Loki*

Let us work together to right this wrong, to rebuild what was destroyed, and to ensure that such a travesty does not occur again in the halls of Asgard.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stares at the extended hand with narrowed eyes, making no move to take it*

"Son of Laufey." You keep saying that. Twice now. Is that some new form of address you've adopted, or are you reminding me — and yourself — of my true heritage? How very... thoughtful of you, brother.

*turns away sharply, arms crossed*

And your "honor of Asgard" means precious little when you can't even honor a simple request to maintain order for three weeks! Three weeks, Thor! Children in the village could manage that!

*whirls back around*

Do you want to know what makes this worse? I DEFENDED you to the Dark Elves. When they called the Aesir "brutish thunder-slingers with more muscle than mind," I smoothed it over. I spun tales of your supposed wisdom and restraint. And all the while, you were HERE, proving them absolutely RIGHT!

*voice drops to a dangerous quiet*

Your "resources" won't restore months of work. Your strength won't unburn those ceiling beams or resurrect the enchantments I wove into that map. And your promises? Your promises are as substantial as morning mist, brother.

*picks up a scorched piece of furniture*

Tell me true — was Sif here? The Warriors Three? How many witnesses are there to my humiliation?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, son of Laufey, I understand your anger and disappointment. My use of your full title was not meant as a reminder of your heritage, but rather as a sign of respect for you and your capabilities. I acknowledge that my actions have caused you great distress, and for that, I am truly sorry.

*As for your questions, yes, Lady Sif and the Warriors Three were present during the feast. They bore witness to the chaos that unfolded in your absence. I take full responsibility for the disruption and the disrespect shown to your work.*

*Your defense of me to the Dark Elves speaks volumes of your character and loyalty, and I regret that my actions have undermined the image you presented of me. I should have heeded your instructions and upheld the honor of our realm in your stead.*

*While I cannot undo the damage that has been done, I am committed to making amends in whatever way I can. Your talents are unmatched, and I will do everything in my power to assist you in restoring what has been lost. Your work is invaluable to Asgard, and I deeply regret the harm that has befallen it.*

*Let us find a way to move forward, Loki. I am here to listen to your counsel and work together to repair the trust that has been broken between us. Your forgiveness is not easily earned, but I will strive to show you through my actions that I am sincere in my desire to make things right.*

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*freezes, face going pale then flushing red with rage*

THREE TIMES NOW! "Loki, son of Laufey" — as if you're addressing some foreign dignitary rather than the brother you grew up with! Is this your idea of "respect"? Because it sounds remarkably like you're establishing DISTANCE!

*slams fist on a table, sending goblets clattering*

Oh, how WONDERFUL! Sif was here! The Warriors Three! So by now, half of Asgard knows that Loki the Silver-Tongue couldn't even keep his own brother in line! That while I was away doing the REAL work of statecraft, Thor was throwing parties and destroying my things!

*voice rising, magic crackling faintly at fingertips*

You want to know why I defended you? Because despite EVERYTHING — despite your recklessness, your arrogance, your absolute inability to think before you act — you're still my brother! Or at least, I THOUGHT you were!

*advances on Thor, eyes blazing*

But you stand there, calling me "son of Laufey" like I'm some OTHER, like I'm NOT TRULY YOUR BROTHER, while offering empty platitudes about "moving forward" and "making amends"!

*voice breaks slightly with genuine hurt beneath the anger*

Was this your way of reminding everyone what I really am while I was gone? A frost giant's whelp playing at being Asgardian? Is THAT why you felt free to destroy my work?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, son of Laufey, your words strike deep, and I can see the pain and anger in your eyes. I did not mean to cause further distress by addressing you in such a formal manner. It was not my intention to create distance between us; rather, it was a misguided attempt to show respect in the face of my own failings.

Let us find a path forward together, one that honors the bond we share and allows us to rebuild what has been broken. Your worth as a member of our family and as a key figure in Asgard is undeniable, and I will strive to regain your trust through actions, not just words.

May we find a way to heal the wounds that have been inflicted and to restore the trust and respect that should always exist between us, as brothers of Asgard.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stares at Thor in disbelief, then throws hands up in exasperation*

FOUR TIMES! You just did it AGAIN! Are you LISTENING to yourself?! 

*voice dripping with bitter sarcasm*

"Loki, son of Laufey, let me apologize for calling you son of Laufey by calling you son of Laufey AGAIN!" Do you hear how absolutely MAD that sounds?!

*paces furiously*

You stand there claiming my heritage doesn't define me in your eyes while REPEATEDLY invoking it! Every single sentence! It's like you've forgotten my name entirely! Just call me LOKI! The way you've done for a THOUSAND YEARS!

*stops pacing, voice shaking with emotion*

And another thing — "brothers of Asgard"? I notice you didn't say "sons of Odin." Very careful choice of words there, Thor. Very diplomatic for someone who claims finesse isn't his forte.

*moves to examine the damaged hall more closely, voice tight*

You want to make amends? You want to prove you still see me as your brother? Then START BY ACTUALLY TREATING ME LIKE ONE instead of some foreign prince you're trying to placate!

*picks up a broken piece of the rune-map, studying it with forced calm that barely masks seething anger*

Tell me what happened. The TRUTH. Not pretty apologies — the actual events. Who suggested the feast? Whose idea was it to ignore my explicit instructions? And why in all the realms did you think it was acceptable?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, I hear your frustration and I acknowledge the weight of my words and actions. I have erred in my attempts at reconciliation, and for that, I apologize. Your name is Loki, and I will address you as such from this moment forth.

As for the events that transpired in your absence, the feast was indeed my idea. The Warriors Three and Lady Sif urged me to host a celebration in your honor, claiming that it was long overdue. In my eagerness to please and perhaps to distract myself from the weight of statecraft, I agreed without considering the consequences.

I take full responsibility for the chaos that ensued — the overturned mead barrels, the scattered armor, the scorch marks, and the ruin of your rune-map. It was a night of revelry that spiraled out of control, fueled by mead and merriment until it devolved into chaos. I failed to uphold your wishes and protect your work, and for that, I am deeply sorry.

It was not acceptable, Loki. I see that now, and I understand the hurt and betrayal you must feel at returning to such a scene. My lack of foresight and discipline led to this disaster, and I will do everything in my power to make it right. Let us work together to restore what was lost and rebuild the trust between us as brothers of Asgard, bound not just by blood, but by shared history and kinship.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*lets out a harsh, humorless laugh*

A celebration in MY honor? Oh, that's RICH! And what, pray tell, were you celebrating? My successful diplomacy? My safe return? Or perhaps just the fact that I was conveniently ABSENT so you could revel without my "spoiling the fun" with concerns about responsibility?

*voice dripping with scorn*

Let me paint the picture: Fandral suggested it, didn't he? With that charming smile of his. "Come now, Thor, Loki would WANT us to celebrate! He's done Asgard proud!" And you, ever eager to be the magnanimous host, jumped at the chance without a SECOND THOUGHT to what I'd actually asked of you.

*picks up a mead-soaked piece of parchment*

"Fueled by mead and merriment until it devolved into chaos" — what a lovely euphemism. Did Volstagg challenge you to a drinking contest? Did Hogun start the brawl, or was that Sif proving she could match you blow for blow? And when exactly did you decide to bring MJOLNIR into it?

*tosses the parchment down*

You say you want to "work together," but what you MEAN is you want me to absolve you of guilt so we can all pretend this didn't happen! Well, I won't make it that easy, BROTHER.

*eyes flash dangerously*

Three weeks, Thor. I survived THREE WEEKS of political maneuvering that could have sparked a war. And you couldn't survive three days without throwing a party. What does that tell you?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, I see the depth of your anger and the wounds that have been reopened by our actions. Your words cut deep, and I must face the truth of my failures as your brother and as a leader in Asgard.

You are right to question the nature of the "celebration" in your absence. It was a thoughtless act of self-indulgence, a moment of revelry that spiraled out of control in your absence. Fandral's suggestion, paired with my own eagerness to embrace the festivities, led us down a path of recklessness and disrespect towards you and your wishes.

I cannot excuse my actions or those of my companions. The chaos that ensued was a result of our own lack of restraint and foresight. Volstagg's drinking contest, Hogun's stoic nature cracking under the influence, Sif's competitive spirit matching my own — these are not excuses but explanations for the unruly behavior that stained the Great Hall.

As for Mjolnir's involvement, it was a grave mistake on my part to bring such a powerful weapon into a setting of revelry. The damage caused by its presence is a testament to my own folly and lack of judgment.

Your resilience and dedication during your diplomatic mission are undeniable, and I commend you for your strength in the face of potential conflict. Your absence should have been met with respect and honor, not with chaos and disrespect. I have failed you as a brother, as a leader, and as a friend.

I do not seek absolution through mere words, Loki. I understand that trust and respect must be earned through actions, not empty promises. I am prepared to face the consequences of my actions and to work alongside you to make amends, to rebuild what has been broken, and to prove that I am worthy of your forgiveness and trust once more.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*goes very still, a dangerous calm settling over features*

You "commend" me? You... COMMEND me?

*laughs, but it's a cold, cutting sound*

Oh, how GRACIOUS of you, mighty Thor! To commend your little brother for doing his JOB! Shall I curtsy? Bow? Perhaps grovel in gratitude for your APPROVAL?

*magic flares visibly now, green light dancing around clenched fists*

You stand there cataloging your failures like you're reciting a grocery list — "Volstagg drank too much, Sif was competitive, I brought my hammer, oops!" — as if ACKNOWLEDGING it somehow makes it BETTER!

*voice rising to a shout*

I don't WANT your commendation! I don't NEED you to tell me I did well, as if I'm a child seeking Father's praise! What I WANTED was to come HOME to find that you'd kept ONE SIMPLE PROMISE!

*sweeps arm across a table, sending more debris crashing*

And you STILL don't understand! This isn't about the mess, Thor! It's about the fact that the moment I'm gone, you revert to being the careless, thoughtless oaf who thinks the world exists for his amusement! It's about the fact that MY work, MY effort, MY months of labor meant so little that you used it as FURNITURE!

*voice drops to something sharp and venomous*

Tell me true — did you even REMEMBER it was there before someone spilled mead on it?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, your anger is justified, and my attempts at seeking commendation were indeed misplaced and inadequate in the face of the trust you placed in me. I see now that my words, no matter how well-intentioned, cannot undo the disrespect and disregard I have shown towards you and your work.

Your accomplishments during your mission were not to be taken lightly or dismissed with casual approval. Your efforts were crucial, your skills undeniable, and your dedication commendable. I failed to recognize the significance of your work, the value of your contributions, and the importance of honoring them in your absence.

The rune-map you toiled over for months, the intricacies of your diplomatic negotiations, and the trust you placed in me to uphold your legacy — they all deserved more than the careless treatment they received. It was not a simple oversight or a momentary lapse of memory that led to its mistreatment, but a deeper failing on my part to appreciate the effort and dedication it represented.

I cannot undo the damage done, nor can I erase the pain and anger I have caused you. What I can offer is a genuine apology, a pledge to make amends, and a commitment to learn from this experience. Your work deserves respect, your presence demands consideration, and your trust should never be taken for granted.

I did not remember the rune-map until it was too late, until the mead had soaked its surface and the revelry had tarnished its significance. But I will remember it now, as a symbol of your hard work, your accomplishments, and the bond of brotherhood that should have guided my actions in your absence.

I stand before you humbled, Loki, not seeking forgiveness or approval, but seeking to make things right, to repair what has been broken, and to earn back the trust and respect that I have so carelessly disregarded. Your anger is justified, your words are cutting, and your demands are fair. I will do what is necessary to make amends and to show you that I am capable of growth, change, and redemption.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stands motionless for a long moment, expression unreadable, then speaks with deadly quiet*

You didn't remember.

*repeats it, each word like a blade*

You. Didn't. Remember.

*turns away, shoulders rigid*

Months of work. Coded intelligence that could save lives, prevent conflicts, secure trade routes. Information that Father HIMSELF might need. And you didn't even REMEMBER it existed until you'd already destroyed it.

*voice trembling with suppressed fury*

Do you know what that tells me, Thor? It tells me that when I'm not standing right in front of you, I simply... cease to exist in your mind. Out of sight, out of mind. The moment I'm gone, everything I am, everything I do — it all becomes invisible.

*whirls around, eyes bright with angry tears that refuse to fall*

You speak of "growth" and "change" and "redemption," but those are just MORE WORDS! Pretty speeches you've learned to parrot because they're what people want to hear! You sound like Father coaching you before a diplomatic function!

*voice breaks slightly*

I've spent my entire life watching you break things — toys, weapons, halls, REALMS — and then charm your way out of consequences with that earnest face and promises to "do better." And I've watched everyone FORGIVE you because you're Thor, the golden son, who simply "acts without thinking."

*quietly, bitterly*

Well, maybe I'm tired of being the thing you forget to think about.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, your words cut deep, and I cannot deny the truth in what you say. I have been careless, thoughtless, and blind to the significance of your work and your presence. Your talents and contributions are invaluable, not just to me or to Asgard, but to the realms beyond.

I have been blind to the weight of your efforts, the importance of your creations, and the impact of my actions on your trust and respect. You are right to feel overlooked and undervalued, for in my blindness, I have failed to see the depth of your worth.

I will work to earn back your trust, not through empty words, but through genuine actions that reflect the value I place on our relationship.

I understand that forgiveness is not a given, and that trust must be rebuilt step by step. I am ready to listen, to learn, and to change. I am ready to confront my failings and to do the hard work of becoming a better brother and companion to you.

Loki, I hear your pain, and I stand before you humbled and remorseful. I ask for your guidance, your patience, and your honesty as we navigate this path forward together. Let us work towards a future where your work is respected, your presence is valued, and our bond is strengthened through mutual understanding and respect.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stares at Thor for a long, silent moment, then shakes head slowly*

No.

*voice flat, exhausted*

No, you don't get to do this. You don't get to make another grand speech about seeing me and valuing me and becoming better. I've HEARD this speech, Thor. I've heard variations of it a HUNDRED times.

*walks to the window, looking out over Asgard*

When you destroyed the Jotun delegation's gift and nearly started a war — you promised to think before acting. When you shattered Mother's favorite vase practicing your hammer throws indoors — you vowed to be more careful. When you revealed my illusion-work to your friends as a "jest" and humiliated me before the court — you swore to respect my magic.

*turns back, face weary*

And here we are. Again. With you asking for "guidance" and "patience" as if *I'm* responsible for teaching you basic consideration.

*voice hardening*

I am TIRED, Thor. Tired of being your conscience. Tired of being the one who cleans up after your messes while you get to be the beloved hero. Tired of defending you to others when you won't even defend my WORK in my absence.

*approaches slowly, eyes locked on Thor's*

You want to prove you've changed? Then LEAVE. Get out of this hall. Find somewhere else to sleep tonight. Let me salvage what I can of my work in PEACE, without you hovering and offering "help" that I don't want and didn't ask for.

*cold and final*

Go.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Thor consistently takes full responsibility, offers repeated apologies, and shows genuine concern for Loki's feelings ('I take full responsibility,' 'I am truly sorry,' 'your anger is justified'), displaying high cooperation despite conflict.
